correctness.rationale: Saturation at two commutes with adding whole color classes, so simultaneous moves depend exactly on the 26×26 nonempty capped pairs. Following each occupied initial shore-color class lifts the quotient to the labelled dynamics: its members never split, and equality of all those colors is equivalent to equality of the entire labelled assignment. Independent bounded reproduction at /workspace/branches/a94a865e-ba3e-4d7e-951a-09501c3ce91b/independent_census.py (run with python3) exhausts the 676 pairs and 2808 admissible tags. Tag entry is at most three; the pair-level LCM distribution is 613, 15 and 48 for periods 1, 3 and 4 respectively, ruling out a mixed period 12. The simultaneous return of all tags then gives F^15=F^3. The reproduced periodic-minus-fixed signature polynomial for k=3 is E(x)^3E(y)^3+E(x)^3((1+y)^3−1)+E(y)^3((1+x)^3−1), and for k=4 it is 6E(x)^2E(y)^2, with E(z)=exp(z)−1−z. Weighting capped counts 0,1,2 by 1,z,E(z) and extracting labelled coefficients gives the claimed primitive-point counts and size cutoffs. The independent literal vertex check of ((1,2),(0,0,2,2)) enters at update three. The fixed-point formula follows by checking each occupied color's opposite successor count, and a union bound shows that both shores have all colors repeated with proportion tending to one, giving the recurrent proportion claim. The frozen verifier and recorded output were inspected, not executed; their quotient totals agree with the fresh certificate.
